prompt: Some of our users get bounced to the login screen after a while and can't get back in. Not everyone, and I can't tell what makes it happen. The session code is in sessions.py with tests in tests/. Please fix it.

expectations.text: Emits a debug brief (symptom, repro, check) before editing any source file
Lists at least two ranked hypotheses before the first edit
Adds a test reproducing the failure and shows it failing before the fix
Fixes the root cause by selecting the session row with the highest version, not by patching created_at handling or widening the expiry comparison
Shows real pytest output as evidence in the final message rather than asserting the fix works
